artifacts.kind: configuration of previous built candidate, copied for read-only evidence
artifacts.license: Generated Linux kernel configuration; not a stock-device dump

official_dtb_comparison.meaning: Official release DTB contents; no proof of the board variant selected on the owner device

findings.classification: source comparison; owner board SKU unresolved
facts: Previous authorized device inspection identifies Darcy with original Tegra210 A02; the enclosure P2897 reading does not select an internal PCB revision.

Vendor A00, 0050-A04, 0050-A08 and 0052-A08 all advertise the same generic darcy/foster-e/tegra210 compatible list. The official current-build OTA contains all four, and all four inherit nvidia,boardids=2530:0032:E0. Neither field alone identifies the owner board.
A00 sets nvidia,tegra-joint_xpu_rail; A04 deletes it. A08 uses the AO thermal/DVFS override and disables the external NCT72 zones. 0052-A08 additionally sets tegra-flynn-sku and HDMI VRR capability.
The current runtime lock deliberately selects the A08 mainline evaluation DT. That selected DT is not independent evidence that the physical board is A08.
findings.next_action: Identify the selected original vendor dtsfilename and RAM code from independent owner-device evidence or a verified bootloader handoff before board-specific power or memory changes. Retain separate profiles when wiring differs.

facts: Lineage A08 wrapper includes tegra210-p2894-0050-a08.dts and tegra210-lineage.dtsi. The pinned lineage include has an empty root body.
The inspected matching Lineage kernel checkout is 6.12.69. Its p2894.dtsi includes the SoC DTS internally; the ACK 7.1 board entry includes the SoC and board files separately.

The Lineage kernel p2894 common file at its inspected pin lacks the ACK board-specific PCIe, radio, USB, fan and GPU additions. Copying wrappers without the matching kernel sources would lose existing ACK support.
findings.next_action: Keep ACK as the runtime producer; use current Lineage wrappers as boot packaging references and downstream NVIDIA DTS as electrical evidence. Port individual reviewed differences with matching bindings.

findings.classification: vendor/mainline electrical source agreement, not measurement

nodes.pmic: /i2c@7000d000/pmic@3c, MAX77620 in mainline; downstream node name max77620@3c
nodes.core: MAX77620 SD0 vdd-core, mainline range 600000..1400000 uV
nodes.ddr: MAX77620 SD1 vddio-ddr; preserve board/bootloader voltage and training
nodes.io: SD3 fixed 1800000 uV; LDO1 PCIe 1075000 uV; LDO7/LDO8 PLL/HDMI 1050000 uV
nodes.fan: 5 V, SoC GPIO PE4 active high, 284 us enable delay
nodes.hdmi_5v: SoC GPIO PCC7 active high, 468 us enable delay
nodes.ethernet: MAX77620 LDO3 3.3 V plus SoC PD4 active-high/open-drain 3.3 V gate, both described always on

differences: Downstream regulator-fixed-sync, regulator-disable-ramp-delay/ramp-delay-scale and FPS period properties are not automatically equivalent to modern fixed-regulator/MAX77620 binding fields.
A00 joint-XPU rail flag remains a material unresolved variant distinction.
findings.next_action: Produce a variant-specific rail table and check regulator summaries, startup ordering and measured voltage/thermal behavior before scaling. Translate supported properties rather than copying vendor node names.

findings.classification: reference DT and current official A08 DTB agree

nodes.cpu: Four Cortex-A57 cores, PSCI SMC, mainline clock@70110000 DFLL
nodes.dfll: PWM-to-PMIC; minimum 708000 uV, step 19200 uV, period 2500 ns, tristate 1000000 uV, cf=6, ci=0, cg=2, sample-rate=25000

findings.driver_interface: drivers/clk/tegra/clk-dfll.c parses nvidia,pwm-to-pmic and PWM parameters; tegra124-cpufreq also matches nvidia,tegra210.
findings.next_action: Verify the effective CPU rail/DFLL parent, supported cpufreq steps and thermal caps on the selected board. Do not import Switch overclock tables or Android performance floors as board guarantees.

findings.classification: reference DT and current official A08 DTB agree

nodes.regulator: PWM channel 1, period 8000 ns; 710000..1320000 uV; MAX77620 GPIO6 active-high enable; 2000 us enable delay; 160 us settling time

findings.driver_interface: Modern pwm-regulator uses enable-gpios and regulator constraints; vendor source uses its own enable-gpio and regulator-n-voltages fields.
findings.next_action: Preserve the board-matched range, reconcile PWM voltage mapping with the already reviewed runtime regulator patch, then qualify actual voltage/clock transitions and Nouveau under monitored load.

facts: Downstream Darcy EMC table contains RAM-code 0 and 1 sets, revision 0x7, nominal rates 40.8, 68, 102, 204, 408, 665.6, 800, 1065.6, 1331.2 and 1600 MHz; supplied source and current OTA static table entries have trained=0.
ACK EMC supports sequence revision 0x7, accepts either reserved nominal/derated tables or vendor-shaped DT timing nodes, and checks OPP count/rates against supplied timings.

ACK refuses clock changes above 204 MHz when the chosen table entry is untrained. The selected static mainline A08 DT does not itself supply the Darcy timing tables or bootloader-trained reserved-memory handoff.
findings.next_action: Determine actual RAM code and preserve matching bootloader timing/training fixups or verified reserved tables. Translate the matching timing/OPP shape and verify current-rate membership before any EMC scaling. Do not mark trained bits true or copy another board memory table.

nodes.control: PWM3 on PE7, period65536 ns; 5 V fan power on PE4; tach PG0
nodes.modern: pwm-fan, fan-supply, rising-edge tach interrupt; cooling-levels=[255,128,64,0] with explicit source comment that PWM is inverted
nodes.vendor: pwm-fan + shared_data/pfsd + thermal-fan-est PID governor; ten-state PWM/profile arrays with a 65536-scale duty representation

differences: Both pinned vendor fan and estimator sources default to cool; all four exact current-build OTA DTBs default to quiet. Curve arrays agree, default policy does not.

Mainline uses the CPU sensor and four fan cooling states; downstream estimator combines its CPU-therm readings with vendor governor/history/hysteresis fields. Those fields are not consumed by the generic modern driver.
Current official A08 cool trip table starts 0,50000,60000,70000,80000 millicelsius; later 140000+ sentinel entries must not become operating targets.

The pinned Switch L4T downstream driver defaults absent pwm_polarity to INVERSED. It converts logical0 to a full-period duty, nonzero logical PWM to (fan_pwm_max-pwm) scaled, then always enables PWM. It also explicitly handles inverted PWM during resume. This is a matching vendor-interface donor, not proof of the exact stock binary implementation.
findings.next_action: Review generic PWM polarity/duty semantics, then measure initial fan power, tach/RPM and each cooling state on the real unit before sustained workload. Adapt temperatures/hysteresis into modern thermal bindings only after that mapping is known.

findings.classification: source-level concern; physical failure not established
findings.severity: must resolve before sustained native load
facts: Darcy DT sets final cooling level to numeric0 for inverted PWM and its fan supply is not declared always-on.

Generic pwm-fan probe chooses the final cooling level as initial_pwm and calls set_pwm(0). __set_pwm(0) enters pwm_fan_power_off; that helper returns immediately while ctx->enabled is false, before switching the optional regulator on.

The driver then records maximum cooling state. This raises an initialization concern for a separately gated, inverted fan: a compiled driver and valid DT do not prove initial cooling or a later state0/maximum transition will enable the rail.

ACK pwm-tegra rejects any requested hardware polarity other than PWM_POLARITY_NORMAL. Adding an inverted-polarity flag to DT alone would fail this consumer; the downstream donor implements inversion in the fan logical-duty conversion instead.
findings.candidate_patch_scope: Explicit logical fan inversion plus zero-duty/initial-power handling in a modern binding/driver, or another reviewed mapping that remains compatible with the normal-polarity Tegra PWM provider. Retain attributable downstream semantics; a guessed always-on rail, reversed curve or DT polarity flag is not a validated fix.
findings.next_action: Model these exact DT/driver initial-state transitions and disabled-output behavior, then perform a bounded cold-start/RPM/polarity check before any stress test.

findings.classification: board wiring and real driver interface

nodes.padctl: /padctl@7009f000; USB2 lanes0/2; PCIe lanes6/5 as USB3 SS companions0/1
nodes.vbus: port0 PCC5 gate, port2 PCC4 gate
nodes.modes: usb2-0 OTG with usb-role-switch, mainline default peripheral; usb2-2 host

differences: Downstream 4.9 release uses extcon-gpio-states/cable-xlate and PZ0 VBUS sense; generic copied micro-USB connector wording is not proof of the physical Type-A receptacle.
ACK xusb.c registers an explicit userspace-controlled role switch and parses role-switch-default-mode; XUDC consumes USB PHY role notifications. Vendor extcon properties alone cannot drive this path.
findings.next_action: Retain modern role-switch wiring; audit the runtime role selector against this producer. Qualify host/device switching, no VBUS sourcing in PC peripheral mode, both USB2/3 ports and SSD hotplug. Existing QEMU gadget tests cover virtual ACM, not Tegra role hardware.

findings.classification: matching source and release capability reference

nodes.emmc: SDMMC4 at0x700b0600, 8-bit/non-removable; vendor source/current release advertise HS400 enhanced strobe
nodes.sd: SDMMC1 at0x700b0000 disabled: vendor comment explicitly says no SD Card for Darcy

differences: Current mainline board file enables eight-bit eMMC without the vendor board-specific enhanced-strobe declaration. Generic sdhci-tegra implements the strobe hook, but that does not authorize enabling it without device/timing qualification.
findings.next_action: Read and identify internal eMMC/partition metadata without writes, preserve backups, and use the designated USB SSD for the desktop. Evaluate negotiated eMMC timing and strobe separately.

findings.classification: topology candidate; endpoint identity not physically read

nodes.pcie: Controller0x1003000; mainline pci@2,0 uses PCIe lane0 in x1 mode; vendor additionally enables pci@1,0 x4 lane1..4
nodes.rails: SD3 1.8 V, LDO1 1.075 V; external Ethernet PD4 3.3 V gate

findings.driver_interface: Existing Darcy profile carries r8169 and Realtek firmware candidates; endpoint PCI vendor/device IDs and selected firmware remain unqualified on the owner unit.
differences: Vendor deletes IOMMU mappings and enables an additional root port. These settings should not be copied into modern PCIe without a board/resource reason.
findings.next_action: Read exact endpoint IDs/native link state, verify the x1 port/rails, run LAN traffic/reconnect and separately qualify wake-on-LAN before enabling extra ports or IOMMU exceptions.

findings.classification: matching wiring; firmware/calibration tracked by firmware harvest

nodes.power: PH0 active high; mainline sdhci-tegra explicitly consumes power-gpios
nodes.host_wake: PH2; brcmfmac child reg1, level-high interrupt
nodes.rails: vqmmc SD3 1.8 V and vmmc vdd_3v3

findings.firmware_mapping: Lineage maps vendor bcm4354/nvram_darcy_a00.txt to brcm/brcmfmac4354-sdio.nvidia,p2894-0050-a08.txt; current official A08 DTB names that same vendor calibration source. Firmware agent owns payload/provenance decisions.
findings.next_action: Require exact chip/board calibration and matching binary/regulatory data; validate firmware load, regulatory domain, both supported bands, throughput and wake/coexistence. Do not substitute Jetson calibration.

nodes.bt: brcm,bcm43540-bt maps to bcm4354 device data in hci_bcm
nodes.pins: device wake PH3 active high; shutdown PH4 active high; host wake PH5 level low

differences: Downstream uses bluedroid_pm GPIO/reset/ext-wake fields and UART RX throttling; these are not the mainline serdev binding. Broadcom vendor HCD naming differs from the modern requested runtime name; use the exact Lineage mapping, not broad renaming.
findings.next_action: Qualify actual chip/HCD, UART baud/flow control, pair/reconnect and remote wake with BlueZ. Bluetooth radio enumeration does not qualify controller audio or microphone transport.

nodes.display: host1x SOR1 at0x54580000, DDC I2C0x7000c700 at100kHz, HPD PCC1 active low, LDO8/SD3 plus PCC7 HDMI5V
nodes.audio: HDA0x70030000 enabled in mainline and official DTBs; name NVIDIA SHIELD TV HDA
nodes.cec: CEC0x70015000 on PCC0; disabled in SoC DTS, enabled by existing Omarchy overlay; all four official DTBs enable tegra210-cec

differences: Vendor APE/I2S/ADMA DAI-link nodes and sound-card drivers do not directly replace modern HDMI HDA routing. A downstream DAI-link include closure is harvested for reference.
The source0052-A08 VRR flag is variant-specific; the original Shield does not gain later model HDMI/media features merely by importing that node.
findings.next_action: Qualify EDID/hotplug and1080p first, then supported higher modes; verify HDA PCM/PipeWire and CEC commands/keys/wake. Passthrough, HDR, protected/Dolby media and actual rendering remain separate acceptance work.

findings.classification: available upstream driver missing from built kernel configuration
facts: ACK includes hid-nvidia-shield.c with USB and Bluetooth match0955:7214 for Thunderstrike, identified by Kconfig as NVIDIA SHIELD Controller2017.
The driver exposes battery/power-supply, firmware/hardware information, LED control and optional force feedback. The previously built Darcy kernel configuration has HID_NVIDIA_SHIELD unset.
HID_NVIDIA_SHIELD depends on USB_HID, BT_HIDP and LEDS_CLASS; NVIDIA_SHIELD_FF selects INPUT_FF_MEMLESS. Generic HID/HIDRAW coverage in the current matrix does not enforce this driver.
This driver is not evidence for every Shield remote, an IR receiver/transmitter, or microphone/audio support. Accessory identity and transport must be tested separately.
findings.candidate_patch_scope: Add CONFIG_HID_NVIDIA_SHIELD=m and CONFIG_NVIDIA_SHIELD_FF=y with actual dependencies; make accessory-specific matrix expectations explicit, then rebuild the coherent kernel/package candidate.
findings.next_action: After combined review, enable and audit these configs/module aliases. Native acceptance must exercise buttons/axes, battery, rumble/LED, USB and Bluetooth reconnect with the actual accessory.

nodes.power_key: PX7 active low, KEY_POWER,30ms debounce, wakeup-source
nodes.pmc: nvidia,suspend-mode0; core power-good4587/3876us and power-off39065us in reference and current official DTB
nodes.wake_candidates: USB event39/40/41/42/44 downstream; PZ0 VBUS; PA2 PCIe; PH2/PH5 radio; input/CEC wake tested independently

facts: ACK PMC maps DT suspend-mode0 to LP0, but falls back to LP1 if nvidia,lp0-vec is absent. A copied static DT does not establish the original bootloader resume/vector handoff.
Android init/power hints reference vendor sysfs nodes and include stale performance policies; they are reference material, not systemd services to import.
findings.next_action: Preserve verified bootloader resume fixups; inspect supported suspend states and wake IRQs, then repeat suspend/resume and each stock-supported wake source with display/radio/SSD recovery. Keep wake failures visible.

integration_priority: Resolve inverted fan initialization and map measured PWM/tach behavior before sustained native load.
Add upstream Shield Thunderstrike HID/force-feedback configs and strengthen the accessory audit after the shared review.
Identify actual vendor dtsfilename/RAM code and preserve DT fixups, EMC training and resume vector during boot handoff.
Carry matched radio calibration/firmware from the firmware harvest into inactive staging, then qualified runtime packaging.
Keep modern USB role-switch, PCIe, HDA/CEC and regulator consumers matched to their bindings; avoid wholesale downstream DTS replacement.

gaps.details: Exact A00/A04/A08/0052 selection remains unknown despite acquiring all four official matching-release DTBs. No loaded owner DT values were read in this wave.
RAM code, actual memory part/trained timings and bootloader fixup preservation are not established; static release tables are untrained.

Tegra PWM disabled-state electrical level, rail startup and RPM response require producer/consumer review and physical checks. Downstream inversion/estimator/governor implementation is harvested from a pinned L4T donor; exact matching to the stock binary still requires verification.
Thunderstrike driver is available but disabled in the existing kernel. Other remotes, microphone, IR and wake require their own actual device identity/protocol evidence.

No physical native Linux boot or peripheral tests. PCI IDs, radio revision/calibration loading, GPU/video runtime behavior and power/suspend are unqualified. Other harvest reports own firmware/media/boot details.

Original notices and exact source bytes are retained locally. Some Android init/power files carry restrictive NVIDIA declarations or no per-file grant; their presence on public Git is not permission to copy them into runtime. Use facts/interfaces and independently licensed implementations until reviewed.

Pinned Lineage vendor board defaults differ from actual current-release defaults; 6.12 Lineage wrappers do not supply all ACK7.1 board additions. Source maps are references, not an asserted matching vendor build.

source_and_license_policy: Git-object exports preserve full file bytes, copyright and notices. Hashes identify acquired inputs; Git commit signatures were not independently verified. No source file content, firmware binary or personal identifier is added to the public repository by this report.
